company_name: 康佳集团股份有限公司
decision_frame: Pre-outcome enterprise underwriting at the 2018-12-31 cutoff, separating operating economics, owner cash accessibility, financing continuity and permanent-loss paths.
underwriting_route: Conditional operating owner-cash route with explicit financing and realization uncertainty.

situation_model.summary: The appliance profit pool is heterogeneous across categories and channels; aggregate industry growth cannot establish 康佳's product-level economics. Company evidence shows diversified multimedia, supply-chain, white-goods and mobile activities with weak recent cash conversion.

industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: Category and channel growth continue but profit-pool capture diverges by product mix, bargaining power, inventory and working-capital discipline.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: Demand and channel shifts reach company earnings through product mix, realized pricing, unit costs, inventory and receivable conversion; only responsibility-matched disclosures can confirm transmission.
industry_future_thesis.company_exposure: 康佳 participates in domestic and export television/display sales, supply-chain trading and other appliance/mobile activities; segment-level cash and capital data are not disclosed.
industry_future_thesis.adaptation: 2017 multimedia integration around television/display products and corporatization of domestic/export sales show organizational adaptation, but customer adoption, unit economics and cash absorption remain unverified.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: Reported FY2017 earnings are dominated by a disclosed non-sustainable property disposal gain; recurring earning power is therefore conditional and broad-range only.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: Receivables and inventory expanded while operating cash flow turned deeply negative and borrowings rose, creating a path of slow value destruction if working capital and low-return projects persist.
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Use a conditional operating owner-cash route; exclude non-recurring disposal proceeds from normal earnings and keep growth-project value scenario-only until matched returns and cash realization are evidenced.
industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: Aggregate industry growth and consolidated accounting profit may overstate company-specific economics; a rival explanation is that mix, exports, channel migration and one-off disposals, rather than durable product-level advantages, explain the observed results.
reversal_observations: Company same-basis disclosures show category or channel exposure inconsistent with the common industry environment, or national aggregate data cannot enter its target product market.
Changes in sell-through are explained by exports, seasonality, accounting scope or inventory shifts and cannot support company demand or cash transmission.
Acquisitions, consolidation scope, financing or product-boundary changes make cross-period earnings, working capital or capital spending incomparable.
Company evidence shows realized price, unit cost, customer absorption or cash collection moving opposite to the candidate main path.

business_position: 康佳 has broad channel and product reach, including domestic B2B/B2C and export television sales plus a 136.52亿元 supply-chain business, but no segment-level profitability or cash bridge establishes a durable advantaged position.
survival_case: FY2017 short-term borrowings were 69.27亿元 and long-term borrowings 1.67亿元; operating cash flow was -43.14亿元, indicating financing and working-capital pressure despite disposal cash and no major asset restrictions reported in the annual-report table.
adaptation_case: Multimedia was integrated into a television/display事业群 and a corporatized sales entity was formed. This supports adaptation effort, not yet a proven return; promotion requires product-level customer, margin, working-capital and cash evidence.
normalization_case: FY2015-FY2017 attributable profits (-12.57亿元, 0.96亿元, 50.57亿元) contrast with attributable recurring profits (-11.30亿元, -2.83亿元, -0.97亿元). The 65.878亿元 property disposal gain is explicitly non-sustainable, so normalized earnings remain conditional rather than a point estimate.
permanent_loss_map: Permanent-loss risk is driven by persistent receivable/inventory absorption, rising borrowings, low-return retention and unproven project economics; disposal proceeds may reduce near-term financing pressure but do not repair recurring earning power.

value_route.route_reasoning: The only currently supportable route is a conditional operating owner-cash bridge. Asset-disposal receipts are non-recurring and growth-project returns are not matched to component cash flows, so both remain excluded or scenario-only.

strongest_rival: Aggregate industry growth and consolidated accounting profit may overstate company-specific economics; a rival explanation is that mix, exports, channel migration and one-off disposals, rather than durable product-level advantages, explain the observed results.
reversal_observations: Company same-basis disclosures show category or channel exposure inconsistent with the common industry environment, or national aggregate data cannot enter its target product market.

component_treatments.reason: Television/display is a named core business with integration evidence but no responsibility-matched margin or cash disclosure.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Include only a conditional normal-earnings and owner-cash range; do not assume durable advantage.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Disclose same-basis product sales, realized price, unit cost, receivable/inventory conversion and cash for a mature period.

component_treatments.reason: Supply-chain management contributes 136.52亿元 revenue, yet trading margin, working-capital and cash conversion are not separately disclosed.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Keep in conditional operating range and financing-pressure analysis; no standalone return claim.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Provide segment profit, working-capital turnover and cash-flow reconciliation on the supply-chain responsibility unit.

component_treatments.reason: Projects at Kunshan, Shenzhen, Dongguan and Yibin have disclosed names and aggregate investment but no component return evidence.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Exclude from base earnings and owner cash; consider only as a growth scenario with financing pressure.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Match project spending, customer acceptance, incremental earnings and cumulative owner cash.

component_treatments.reason: The 65.878亿元 Kangqiao Jiayuan disposal gain is explicitly identified as non-sustainable.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Remove from normal earnings; recognize only as historical financing liquidity, not recurring owner cash.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Only a repeated, ordinary-shareholder-accessible realization stream could change this treatment.

component_treatments.reason: Borrowings and negative operating cash are directly disclosed at consolidated level and determine financing continuity.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Increase financing-pressure assessment and cap confidence in owner-cash conversion.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Show sustained operating cash recovery and debt reduction without disposal dependence.

evidence_trace.locator: FY2015-FY2017 annual reports cash-flow and balance-sheet pages 18-21,74,78,88
evidence_trace.scope: Operating cash flow, capex, receivables, inventory and borrowings
Named major non-equity projects and reported investment
Borrowing proceeds and debt repayment cash flows
Kangqiao Jiayuan disposal proceeds and non-sustainable gain

underwriting_thesis.central_path: Diversified appliance exposure and organizational adaptation are offset by unproven segment economics, negative operating cash and debt-funded working capital; underwrite only conditional operating economics.
underwriting_thesis.normal_earnings_treatment: Use a broad conditional range anchored to recurring-profit history; exclude the disclosed non-sustainable disposal gain and avoid segment precision.
underwriting_thesis.owner_cash_treatment: Treat owner cash as conditional because operating cash flow is negative and cash accessibility by entity is not disclosed; distinguish maintenance capex from total spending without inventing a point estimate.
underwriting_thesis.permanent_loss_treatment: Base path is slow per-share value erosion from working-capital absorption, rising leverage and low-return retention; disposal liquidity lowers near-term pressure but is not recurring economics.
underwriting_thesis.value_route_treatment: Primary route is conditional operating owner cash; growth and asset-realization routes remain scenario-only or excluded pending matched realization evidence.
underwriting_thesis.strongest_rival: Aggregate industry growth and consolidated accounting profit may overstate company-specific economics; a rival explanation is that mix, exports, channel migration and one-off disposals, rather than durable product-level advantages, explain the observed results.
underwriting_thesis.monitoring: At the feedback clocks, test same-basis category/channel exposure, recurring margins, receivable and inventory conversion, operating cash, debt and ordinary-shareholder realization.

investment_treatment: Research-only conditional underwriting; no price, return, valuation result or investment action is authorized.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Segment-level product margin, working-capital and cash evidence over a mature period.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Same-basis disclosures show persistent losses or cash absorption inconsistent with the operating route.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Disclose supply-chain margin and responsibility-matched cash conversion.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Trading margins and working capital remain structurally value destructive.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Matched project return and cumulative owner-cash evidence.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Projects consume capital without customer adoption or adequate incremental return.
Gain remains one-off and unavailable to recurring operations.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Sustained operating cash recovery and debt reduction.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Refinancing dependence or debt growth persists without recurring cash support.
